questions.qtext: Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?

options.text: Head loss must be equal for pipes connected in parallel.
Head lost due to friction must be equal to one-third of total head for maximum power transmission through a pipeline.
Cavitation can be prevented by reducing the velocity head.
When the flow contracts, it tends to become rotational due to increase in pressure.

questions.solution:
(a, b, c)
• Cavitation can be prevented by reducing the velocity head as pressure head increases.
• When the flow contracts, it becomes rotational due to eddy formation and pressure decreases
after contraction instead of increase.
